balance.rounding: truncate fractional rubles for display; never round source amount
balance.center: fixed centre of amount and currency, excluding eye
balance.numericPath: monotonic magnitude path; new decimal places wait for available width within the same 400ms progress

antiJank.fontFit: endpoint selection only, not per intermediate number
antiJank.currency: same current font size or proportional scale as digits; stable baseline; no separate delay
antiJank.eye: position derived from smoothly interpolated visible reserved width; fixed icon and hit area
antiJank.completion: all values at target at 400ms; no post-animation relayout
antiJank.interruption: restart from current visible number, font, reserved width and eye position

prototypeLimitations.note: Prototype reserve, not a product digit limit; general-width requirements need additional boundary tests
prototypeLimitations.scope: Archived wb-test snapshot, not current wb-test-1

status: Balance motion shared by wb-test and wb-test-1; font reduction required only for measured width overflow

legacyPrototypeAmountLayout.target: measure actual formatted target with current typography + currency gap + currency cell
legacyPrototypeAmountLayout.digitCount: from amount data; not fixed at five or six
legacyPrototypeAmountLayout.grouping: from active formatter; align separators by decimal place during transition
legacyPrototypeAmountLayout.transitionReserve: derive from current visible amount and new target; exclude empty cells from final width
legacyPrototypeAmountLayout.center: centre of available container after padding; 201px is only the 390px demo
legacyPrototypeAmountLayout.status: Archived 2026-10-22; not current balance v5 geometry

amountLayout.status: width-only sizing requirement; ordinary sums verified in wb-test
amountLayout.measurement: actual formatted amount and currency at effective font size within reserved text slot
amountLayout.availableWidth: row width minus symmetric reserves for inset, eye and gap
amountLayout.overflowAtMinimum: right-edge fade in text slot only
amountLayout.blockHeight: fixed by layout, independent of amount
amountLayout.eyePosition: moves with reserved amount width, outside text mask
amountLayout.reducedMotion: final number immediately; same font fit and fade rules
amountLayout.center: fixed centre of amount and currency
amountLayout.eyeGapDuringTransition: may grow to reserve space for upcoming decimal places
amountLayout.fontTransition: continuous only when selected font sizes differ; 10% steps select endpoint only
amountLayout.shrinkCondition: measured formatted amount width > actual available width
amountLayout.fitsAtBase: keep base font size, independent of character count
amountLayout.sameSizeTransition: no font-size animation if both endpoint sizes match

initialLoad.status: v4: single benefits skeleton; fade only; fixed cashback and referral geometry
initialLoad.timeOrigin: T = application content readiness event; all stages relative to T
initialLoad.headerHeight: constant throughout the sequence; from current design

shimmer.repeat: until application content readiness, without a specified repeat limit

reducedMotion.loadingPolicy: same application-defined duration and readiness; static skeletons

initialLoad.replay: initial opening; not back navigation or mode switching
initialLoad.autoplay: timers start at application readiness while home active; categories 20000ms, promo banners 6000ms

loadingPolicy.componentNames: descriptive roles only; implementation names are unrestricted

initialLoad.sizeUnits: design units; corresponding pt on iOS and dp on Android

benefitsSkeleton.mask: one shared rounded rectangle for all benefits
